reason: v13 accepted A-D but E exhausted four attempts. Its last E response had only same-wood beam/roof overlap as the first validation error; an offline lossless same-material de-dup then exposed an entry height mismatch with D's road. This diagnostic enables a bounded, journaled same-material cuboid de-dup and versioned E road-level arithmetic guidance. Different-material overlap, routes, support and all other geometry are still strictly validated. Limits and input equal v13.
scope: One 0.1.0 fixed A-F single-storey building case. Normalization does not replace typed-scene work or prove model reliability.
sample_policy: One run. All started calls count; v1-v13 remain intact. Register any further paid attempt independently.

success.machine: result.json succeeds, source geometry validates, WIR package round-trips, Unity GLB and Minecraft schematic are produced from the same revision, and exact offline replay reproduces package and target hashes.
success.human: Inspect one single-storey timber house, connected street-facing entry and reachable room. Exports do not by themselves prove Unity/Minecraft import or actual walking.
success.report: Record calls, normalizations, failures, elapsed time and provider usage. One pass is not general reliability evidence.
